report.source_notes: Imports & weight: UN Comtrade (Jordan=400, partner World, flow M, CIF USD), pulled 2026-10-09. Customs: WITS/TRAINS MFN simple average 2023. Freight: China->Aqaba 40ft USD 7575 (Goodhope Freight, Sep 2026 quotes 7,300-7,850); payload 6500 kg per container is an estimate. shipping_pct = (freight/payload)/import_price_per_kg_usd; CIF price already includes freight - do not add on top. Raw material: WITS: Jordan imports 730630 welded steel tube 2023 = 4,766.65k USD / 3,199,080 kg. Material ratio (scrap allowance) is an estimate. Conversion cost (labour, energy, overheads) is an estimate. Raw-material availability evidence: estimate. Machinery cost: see machine_source. FX: 1 JOD = 1.4104 USD (CBJ peg 0.709).
report.machine_source: Made-in-China supplier listings, Oct 2026: Tube bender USD 4,000-4,200 (baoruimachinery DW50NC) to 8,000-24,800 (beyongmachine) + powder-coating line USD 5,200-6,000 (jingzhongjing)

explanation.summary: Upholstered metal-frame chair scored 7 out of 10, so local manufacturing looks worth exploring. Indicative break-even: selling about 11 tonnes (2.2% of 2024 imports) at the import-parity price would pay back about 20,000 USD of equipment (equipment only; excludes buildings and working capital).
reasons_for: Imports cost about 5.5 USD/kg including customs (freight is already in the import price), against an estimated local cost of 3.71 USD/kg.
Local capability is reasonable: machinery 4/5, raw materials 3/5, skills 4/5.
Competition is limited: 8 local factories against a saturation level of 20.
concerns: أنابيب الحديد مستوردة جزئياً؛ منافسة سعرية قوية من المنتج الصيني؛ السوق صغير (2.2 مليون دولار سنة 2024)
The import market is modest: about 2.2 million USD in 2024, changing by 5.2% per year.
Cost figures are estimates and must be checked against real supplier quotes.
next_steps: Get written quotes from machinery and raw-material suppliers.
Talk to local wholesalers and retailers to confirm demand and target prices.
Check licensing, standards and incentives with the Jordan Investment Commission and the Chamber of Industry.
caveats: The figures for these items are estimates, not measured values: local production cost, conversion_cost_per_kg_usd, machinery availability, skills availability, number of local factories, market saturation level, shipping cost, protection_pct, material_kg_per_kg_product, local raw materials.
This is a quick screening estimate, not a business plan or financial advice.
